bear.probability_evidence: Beta of 1.47 [ST], short interest of 13.12% and rising (+4.6% month-on-month) [ST], a Piotroski F-score of only 4 [ST], and the 10-K's own admission that passive managers 'have gained and may continue to gain market share from active managers like us' together support a scenario where a market drawdown compounds ongoing outflows (evaluator bear case, note Sections 2 and 6).
